name: Great Aurora
description: Oona's braided aurora that locked the plane in one state for centuries.

timeline.summary: The Great Mending disrupts the Great Aurora cycle, making Oona fear she might be affected.
timeline.quote: This continued until the cycle was disrupted over forty years ago by the Great Mending

pages_say.description: The magical convergence orchestrated by Oona that shifted the whole plane between Lorwyn and Shadowmoor about every three hundred years.
The old plane-wide shift between day and night that Brigid says she did not change in.
The old cycle that once dictated the wakings of the incarnations and that is now gone.
Oona's braided aurora that locked the plane in one state for centuries.
